scope: This mechanical check reviews repeated and trailing spaces. Code, quotations and linked text are protected. It does not check spelling, grammar or facts.
noChanges: Your original changes only when you apply selected suggestions. Formatting and images are retained.
staleNotice: The original has changed. Reload the latest revision before checking it again.
truncated: This review covers only part of the document because limits were reached. Unreviewed content remains unchanged.
invalidInput: Check the selected suggestions and try again.
notFound: This document or review is no longer available.
staleSource: The original changed. Reload it and prepare a new review.
staleProposal: This review no longer matches its saved content. Reload it.
alreadyApplied: This review was already applied with a different selection. Prepare a new check.
unsupportedMode: This review mode is not configured. Spacing checks are available.
unsupportedSource: Structured review requires a rich-text project original.
invalidPatch: These changes conflict with the original or affect protected text. Prepare a new review.
unavailable: Document review is temporarily unavailable. Try again.
crossOrigin: This request must come from the current PandaForce site.
appliedNotice: The selected changes were saved. You can close this review.
channelsHint: Prepare a channel version from this saved original. Post, Thread and Article are separate formats.
uncertainApply: The response was interrupted. Retry the same selection; it will not be applied twice.
modelScope: Review model suggestions before applying them. Code, quotations and linked text are protected.
providerScope: Editable text is sent to this configured provider. Closing this panel does not cancel the task.
noProcessors: No processing model is configured. Spacing checks remain available.
failureInterrupted: The task was interrupted repeatedly. You can retry it explicitly.
failureUnavailable: The saved processing profile is unavailable or has changed.
failureInvalid: The provider returned an invalid or refused response. Your original was not changed.
failureTimeout: The processing time limit was reached. You can retry.
failureProcessing: The provider request failed. Check the processing connection or retry.
processorsUnavailable: Unable to load processing models. Refresh processing tasks to try again.
invalidProcessorConfiguration: The processing connection is misconfigured. Ask an administrator to check it. Spacing checks remain available.
workingCopyChanged: Save or discard unsaved changes before applying suggestions to the saved original.
pendingApply: This selection is confirmed. Retry to recover the same result; other suggestions stay unchanged.
